name: Nespresso Uruguay
description: Official Nespresso online store for Uruguay, built on Shopify. Sells Nespresso coffee capsules, coffee machines and accessories. States shipping to any part of the country for orders above a stated threshold, dispatch within 24 hours, and pickup through pickup points and boutiques.
